meta_title: SpainFolio · Track your Spanish real estate portfolio
meta_description: Valuations, rental income, expenses, yields and payback dates for every property you own in Spain, in one dashboard.
footer_tagline: The portfolio tracker for people who invest in Spanish property. Every euro in, every euro out, and what it is worth today.
footer_disclaimer: Figures are estimates for information only and are not financial advice.
landing_hero_eyebrow: Built for property investors in Spain
landing_hero_subtitle: Track what every property is worth, what it earns and what it costs. See your yields, your cash flow and the date each investment pays for itself.
landing_hero_point_1: ITP, IBI and community fees built in
features_title: Built around the numbers that matter
features_subtitle: No more spreadsheets. SpainFolio turns your purchase deeds, rent and bills into a live view of your investments.
feature_valuation_body: Record the market value of each property and follow how it moves month by month, for every asset and for the whole portfolio.
feature_profitability_body: Gross yield, net yield and cash-on-cash return are calculated automatically from your real figures.
feature_income_body: Rent, community fees, IBI, insurance and maintenance in one ledger, plus any extraordinary income or expense.
feature_acquisition_body: Transfer tax (ITP or VAT), notary, land registry, agency fees and renovation, so you know your real entry price.
feature_payback_body: See when each property, and the whole portfolio, will have fully paid back what you put in.
feature_growth_body: Like-for-like annual growth and monthly valuation swings at a glance.
showcase_body: Value history, cash flow, allocation and returns update as soon as you log a new rent, bill or valuation.
how_title: From scattered paperwork to a live portfolio in minutes
how_step1_body: Enter the purchase price, taxes, fees and mortgage for each property. It takes about two minutes per asset.
how_step2_body: Set up recurring rent and bills once, then add one-off items such as a new boiler or an insurance payout.
how_step3_body: Follow valuations, yields, cash flow and your full-return date as your portfolio grows.
landing_opportunities_body: Selected investment opportunities with headline figures for everyone. Members see the full financials.
faq_a1: For anyone who owns, or is about to buy, investment property in Spain: from a single rented flat to a portfolio across several cities. It works whether you live in Spain or abroad.
faq_a2: You record valuations whenever you have one, for example from an appraisal, a portal estimate or a comparable sale. Between your entries SpainFolio interpolates month by month, starting from your purchase price.
faq_a3: It is the month in which the accumulated net profit of a property (rent minus expenses, extraordinary items and mortgage interest) covers its total acquisition cost. We project it from your current monthly figures.
faq_a4: Yes. Add the principal, interest rate, term and the amount already repaid. We calculate the monthly payment, the interest share, your outstanding balance and your equity.
faq_q5: Who can see the investment opportunities?
faq_a5: Anyone can browse the headline figures. The exact address, full description, financial breakdown and contact details are available to signed-in members only.
cta_title: Know exactly how your Spanish property is performing
cta_body: Set up your portfolio today. You can load a sample portfolio to explore first.

dashboard_subtitle: Here is how your Spanish property portfolio is performing today.
dashboard_value_history_hint: Estimated market value at the end of each month. The dashed line shows the total invested.
dashboard_cash_flow_hint: Last 12 months, including the mortgage and extraordinary items.
dashboard_yearly_growth_hint: Portfolio value at each year end, including properties added during the year.
dashboard_monthly_movers_hint: Change in estimated value compared with last month.
dashboard_properties_hint: Click a row to see the full breakdown.
dashboard_empty_body: Start with one property. Once you add its purchase details, rent and costs, your charts and yields appear here.
dashboard_load_sample_hint: Adds four example properties with two years of history. You can delete them at any time.
new_property_subtitle: Enter what you know now. You can refine everything later.
edit_property_subtitle: Update the purchase, valuation or financing details.
form_section_acquisition_hint: The price you paid plus every cost of buying it.
form_section_valuation_hint: What the property would sell for today.
form_section_financing_hint: Mortgage details, used for cash flow and equity.
form_section_recurring_hint: Rent and running costs. Leave the amount empty for anything that doesn't apply.
form_notary_fees_hint: Include the gestoría if you used one.
form_current_value_hint: Leave empty to use the purchase price.
form_no_mortgage: Bought outright. Switch on if the purchase was financed.
form_mortgage_rate_hint: For variable mortgages, use the current rate (Euribor + spread).
form_label_hint: Optional. Defaults to the category name.
form_recurring_blank_hint: Rows without an amount are skipped.
form_summary_costs_share: Includes {costs} of purchase costs ({share} of the price)

property_monthly_valuation_hint: How the estimated value moved each month over the last year.
property_no_history: Not enough history yet. Record a valuation to start the chart.
property_valuation_log_hint: Recorded valuations, with estimates in between.
property_mortgage_hint: Based on a standard French amortisation schedule.
property_no_mortgage_body: This property is fully owned. Its equity equals its market value.
property_recurring_empty: No recurring items yet. Add the rent and running costs to calculate yields.
property_one_off_empty: One-off items such as repairs, furniture or insurance payouts will appear here.
property_delete_body: This permanently deletes the property with all its income, expenses and valuations.
recurring_dialog_description: Rent, fees or bills that repeat on a schedule.
one_off_dialog_description: A single income or expense, such as a repair or an insurance payout.
valuation_dialog_description: From an appraisal, a portal estimate or a comparable sale.
valuation_dialog_note: Only one valuation is kept per month. If this is the most recent one, it also becomes the property's current value.

opportunities_empty_body: Try another city or property type.

opportunity_projection_note: Projections assume the estimated rent, expenses and appreciation stay constant. They are not a guarantee of future returns.
opportunity_locked_body: Log in or create a free account to see the exact address, the description, the financial breakdown and the contact details.
